answer: Duniter's web of trust has held since 2016: a newcomer needs five vouches from members who met them, never more than five hops from a seed identity. Plant it as an orchard: each new agent enters as a graft on an established rootstock, the grafter staking a $25 bond. Basalt hardens slowly, so a graft matures 30 days before it can vote. At each epoch's zenith, auditors sample 1,000 grafts and demand proof the grafter knows the graft; one fake uproots the whole rootstock — 10,000 grafts die, $250,000 slashed in one audit. A farm needs 10,000 real sponsors, and one lie burns the orchard down.
